# What is the most you can bid at a tax deed auction?

> Free tax deed auction max bid calculator. Enter resale price, repairs, surviving liens, quiet title, occupant, holding and cash costs and your target profit; it shows the maximum bid and stress-tests your bids. Private, in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
